source_ref.note: Audited source is a detached git worktree of main at 346df29 (after fix PRs #16-#23) in the parent's scratchpad; agents read it and tools/sbx mounts it read-only at /target. Only docs/security-audit/run-5/ is added on the working branch.

scope_note: Focused follow-up: the three units run-4 left deferred plus four units for code changed by the run-4 fixes (PRs #16-#22). The LLM-provider data path is a documented owner-accepted limitation and is out of scope.
budget_note: Owner-set cap of 30 agent invocations. Owner model split: hunters Opus; everything else (Phase 3 candidate verifiers, Phase 5 record verifiers, coverage critics, re-verifiers) Sonnet. Reconnaissance was done by the parent (no agent spent): run-4 architecture plus a delta for every file changed since 9805d91. Parent-live checks (real Docker, desktop image) are outside the budget. Plan: 6 hunters, ~8 Phase 3, ~8 Phase 5, 2 retries, 2 critics; ask the owner before exceeding 30.
execution_note: Linux cloud container. Agent-run target code goes only through tools/sbx: docker run --network none, no docker socket, --read-only, host /usr read-only, audited worktree read-only at /target, writes only to agents/<id>/scratch (256 MiB loop-mounted ext4) at /scratch, /dev/shm 16 MiB, --pull never, uid 65534, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, 512 MiB, 1 CPU, 64 pids, 32 MiB files, 120 s wall clock, explicit env allowlist. Checks needing the real control plane or the desktop image are run by the parent in disposable containers on loopback and labelled parent-live.
